execution: UNEXECUTED behavioral and failure-injection specifications; source inspection only

cases.expect: Declare LABWC_WORKSPACE_COUNT_INTERNAL and LABWC_WORKSPACE_COUNT_EXTERNAL explicitly, each in 1..12; preserve existing internal counts and default the new external count to four.

cases.given: Only an internal output is enabled with a current mode
cases.expect: The existing output watcher selects the internal count under its output-refresh lock and changes only native workspace number and numeric names.

cases.given: An external output is enabled, alone or together with the internal panel
cases.expect: Select the external count for Labwc global workspace set, shared by all enabled monitors; never claim independent per-monitor workspaces.

cases.given: An external connector is detected but disabled by the chosen output policy
cases.expect: Keep the internal count; connector presence alone is insufficient.

cases.given: The enabled topology changes between internal-only and external-enabled
cases.expect: Use the subscribed existing output watcher; publish only when count differs and issue one bounded native reconfiguration request. Do not restart Waybar or the compositor to change count.

cases.given: Outputs are asleep or the snapshot has no enabled output
cases.expect: Preserve the pre-idle workspace policy and do not misclassify sleep as undocking.
Keep native ext/workspaces and the current-workspace window switcher; do not expose stock global wlr/taskbar as a workspace-local list.

cases.given: Any tier and either output topology
cases.expect: Preserve native workspace/status module identities and existing GTK menu owners; no custom workspace broker or extra polling process.

cases.given: A missing count, 0, 13, whitespace, leading zero or shell expression
cases.expect: Reject profile generation or target policy validation without executing profile content.

cases.given: A symlink, hardlink, untrusted ancestor, changed inode, oversized XML, DTD/entity declaration or duplicate desktop structure
cases.expect: Refuse publication and preserve the previous XML and unrelated configuration.

cases.given: A count change would replace nonnumeric manually configured workspace names
cases.expect: Refuse the automatic change with an explicit operator-policy diagnostic.

cases.given: The bounded native reconfiguration request fails or times out after publication
cases.expect: Retain private previous XML and the published candidate; refuse automatic retry until operator recovery resolves the pending file.
Synchronize previous and candidate bytes and the parent directory, then retire recovery only after the native request is acknowledged. Do not claim compositor state was observed.

cases.given: The same profile selected with base, medium or full
cases.expect: Render identical internal/external counts, shortcut capacity and native Waybar behavior.
